summary:
Independent source-only successor design review APPROVE, no critical/high/medium findings. Reviewed frozen TASK-0133 spec d47dab9230837bbe0b850660336066349a4891a67504b08c5afcb00a0c2af355, current context 9d3e9f8b770cfec8538c0059d0c929481d771e0563bb12837d10a8485d725b8c, exact scope/facts and REVIEW/V2 classification 108b858ced80732e5e782df9a11a8d380cf6657d07112cf627ab7fde22e8c333 under unchanged Policy fac8afbe8e1f671338eadc02697a66a3c6aa9ca5494eb25ea97b80812bce4727. This reviewer did not author the production repair or successor specification; this review does not represent an independent review of the three nongit fixture fixes previously authored by this reviewer in the separate test-only baseline.

Verified a74779f1cfd317ba32102dde9d8649f9cfe473cf differs from7530f67 only in the five companion test files, with neither production file changed and f459afc not an ancestor. Creating/classifying the successor here before merging391b7a8 preserves a genuine pre-repair base. A normal merge may retain f459 and the original failed task history without rewriting them; all thirteen imported TASK-0132 paths are explicitly scoped and must remain byte-identical, including BLOCKED state and spent action. The new task's actual verification subject must be synchronized/bound to the merged candidate while base remains a74779f. The complete original39 changed executable production lines therefore remain in the unchanged90percent diff-coverage acceptance boundary; no source change is hidden in a post-repair base, and34/39 is not accepted. New full evidence must establish the resulting coverage, not inherit the failed run's outcome.

The production contract retains only the two direct prerequisites. Node rebinding is limited to successful exact-primary node_check and coverage-suite argv, always comparing complete path/kind/size/SHA256 content to the first independently built build_dist. Coverage helper and all other stages keep full identity protection; read-only replay requires both inventories, equal content and current final identity, and changed semantic inputs stale old materials. Native explicit TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP roots are validated before any mkdir/probe/launch; invalid roots never fall back, each execution gets a separate owned child, only fixed temporary roles augment the minimal child environment, and Policy cannot inject them. Source/runtime/dependency/root/process guards, every original check and native mutation,85percent total and90percent diff thresholds remain unchanged.

This is design approval only. It does not record spec/code/action approval, spend an action, run tests/mutations, finalize evidence or establish Gate/remote CI success. The unchanged production repair must receive fresh complete native V2 with the corrected test baseline, current independently reviewed single-use action, independent verifier, subsequent implementation review and same-verifier finalization. Exact-head required remote CI remains mandatory. OldTASK0132 evidence, failures, approvals and spent action remain historical, never current authority. No installed Node V2/CI activation, real target write, authorization change, threshold reduction, model/WeChat execution, private transfer or repository-setting change is included.
